newPhone.question: I'm switching to a new phone
newPhone.answer: Install Keeplas on the new phone and sign in with your number and the WhatsApp code. Tap "Restore from iCloud" (or Google): a WhatsApp code confirms it's you and your vault opens. Keep the old phone until then, then remove it in Settings › Devices.

platform.question: My new phone is another brand
platform.answer: The cloud backup stays with the old phone's brand: it doesn't reach the new one. Keep the old phone: on the new one, choose "Another signed-in device" and approve from the old one. Otherwise, use your 24-word kit or your trusted contacts. The backup then turns on again on the new phone.

lostPhone.question: I lost my phone
lostPhone.answer: Nobody can open your vault on it: it's locked by Face ID, fingerprint or the phone passcode. On a new phone, sign in and restore from iCloud or Google. Then remove the lost phone in Settings › Devices so its session ends.

lostNumber.question: I lost my phone number
lostNumber.answer: On the sign-in screen, tap "Lost your number?". With your 24 words, you change it right away. Without them, our team checks your request and nothing changes for 72 hours.

lostAuthenticator.question: I lost my authenticator app
lostAuthenticator.answer: On the code screen, tap "Lost your authenticator app?" and open your vault with your backup or your 24 words. The authenticator code is turned off; you can set up a new one later.

nothingLeft.question: I have no backup and no 24 words
nothingLeft.answer: Ask your trusted contacts: two of them approve, then Keeplas waits 72 hours. Without any of these ways, nobody can open your vault, not even Keeplas: that's what keeps it private.

backup.question: What does the cloud backup do?
backup.answer: Keeplas keeps an encrypted copy of your vault key, and what opens it stays in your iCloud or Google keychain. Neither Keeplas nor Apple or Google can open it alone. Restoring it also asks for a WhatsApp code.

kit.question: Do I need the 24 words?
kit.answer: No. They're an optional kit you can create in Settings › Privacy and security, for a way back that depends neither on the cloud nor on your contacts. Anyone with these words can open your vault: keep them offline.

wait.question: Why wait 72 hours?
wait.answer: The wait gives you time to see a request you didn't make and cancel it. It only applies to the ways that don't prove it's you directly: your trusted contacts, or a lost number without your 24 words.

notMe.question: Someone is trying to get into my account
notMe.answer: You get an alert on your devices, by email and on WhatsApp. Open Keeplas and tap "It wasn't me" to cancel the request. Nothing is released while the 72 hours run.

travelMode.question: What is travel mode?
travelMode.answer: It pauses Life check for 30 days while you're away. Keeplas sends no check-ins, cancels a check-in in progress and doesn't contact your contacts. Turn it off anytime in Settings › Life check. When it ends, your countdown starts over.

zeroAccess.question: Can Keeplas open my vault?
zeroAccess.answer: No. Your vault is encrypted on your phone. Our team can check who you are to move your account to a new number, but never open your vault or shorten a wait.

categories.title: Categories
categories.body: Sort your vault your way. Deleting a category deletes its items too: you can restore them from Archives.
categories.inboxBody: Where new items land. It can't be deleted.
categories.deleteItemsOne: Its item will be deleted too. You can still restore it from Settings → Archives.
categories.deleteItems: Its {n} items will be deleted too. You can still restore them from Settings → Archives.

search.label: Search your vault
search.empty: No encrypted items match this search.

lifeCheck.title: Life check
lifeCheck.body: Choose how often Keeplas should ask you to check in.
lifeCheck.paused: Check-ins are paused. Your countdown resumes once Life check is back on.
lifeCheck.resetBody: Only your answer resets the countdown. Using the app doesn't.
lifeCheck.confirmedBody: Your countdown starts over. Next Life check on {date}.
lifeCheck.note: If you miss the check-in window, your contacts are asked to confirm before anything is released.

prompt.title: Are you okay?
prompt.body: This is your regular life check. If we don't hear from you, we'll check again later before taking any further steps.
prompt.footer: A missed check never releases your information.
prompt.failed: We couldn't record your answer. Check your connection and try again.
prompt.missedBody: You didn't answer your last life check. Nothing is shared yet. Let us know you're here.

lifeCheck.changeBody: New frequency: {frequency}. Your countdown starts over from today.
lifeCheck.travelConfirmBody: For 30 days, Keeplas won't ask you to check in and won't contact your contacts. A check-in in progress is cancelled. When it ends, or when you turn it off, your countdown starts over.

backup.title: Cloud backup
backup.bodyShort: Encrypted recovery in your cloud keychain
backup.body: Your vault comes back on a new phone with your {account} account. Keeplas keeps an encrypted copy of its key; what opens it stays in your {account} keychain.
backup.protected: Your backup is protected by your {account} account. Keep it secure with a strong password and two-factor authentication, and your Keeplas backup stays safe too. Restoring it also asks for a code sent to your WhatsApp.
backup.noRootKey: This phone cannot create a cloud backup. Create a new recovery kit first.
backup.notEncrypted: Google can’t encrypt this backup end to end on this phone. Set a screen lock and sign in to your Google account, then try again.

invite.title: You've been invited
invite.from: {name} invited you to become a trusted contact. You can help with recovery, but you cannot read their vault.
invite.invalid: This invitation is invalid, expired, or has already been answered.

selfTest.title: Crypto self-test
selfTest.body: Runs the shared test vectors on this device's native crypto engines.

vaultList.emptyBody: Add your first document, account or note. It’s encrypted before it leaves your phone.

shared.title: Shared with me
shared.body: Vaults of people who chose you as a trusted contact.
shared.emptyBody: When someone makes you a trusted contact, their shared items appear here.
shared.laterOne: Locked. It opens only if {name} stops answering their Life check, 1 trusted contact confirms it, and 72 hours pass with no cancellation.
shared.later: Locked. It opens only if {name} stops answering their Life check, {n} trusted contacts confirm it, and 72 hours pass with no cancellation.
shared.readOnly: Read-only: only what {name} left for you, decrypted on this phone.
shared.unreadable: Can't be opened on this phone
shared.nothingLeft: No readable items were left for you.
shared.notReleasedBody: It opens once this vault is released to you.

help.link: When will I see what they left me?
help.title: When does a vault open?
help.checkInBody: The owner answers a Life check every week, month or quarter. While they answer, their vault stays private, even to you.
help.silentBody: After 15 days without an answer, despite reminders, we alert their trusted contacts, you included.
help.confirmBody: Two of them must confirm the owner can't be reached, unless the owner chose another number.
help.graceBody: The owner is warned and can still cancel. Nothing opens before it ends.
help.yours: You see only what's for you
help.yoursBody: Only the items they left you, read-only, decrypted on this phone.
help.note: If not enough contacts confirm in time, the vault stays locked.

unreachable.body: If you can't reach them either, confirm it. Once enough trusted contacts confirm ({n} needed), they still have 72 hours to cancel.
unreachable.confirmBody: Only confirm after trying to call or message them. You can't undo it, but nothing opens unless enough contacts confirm and 72 hours pass without them cancelling.
unreachable.confirmed: You confirmed you can't reach them
unreachable.waiting: Waiting for the other trusted contacts. {name} can still cancel at any time before anything opens.

passkeys.subtitle: Your passkey signs you in to Keeplas with your face, fingerprint or phone passcode.
passkeys.none: No passkey yet. Add one so you can sign in without a code.
passkeys.add: Add a passkey on this phone
passkeys.why1: It's how you sign in to Keeplas. Your account always needs one.
passkeys.why2: It syncs with your {account} account, so on a new phone you sign in and your vault comes back with your cloud backup.
passkeys.why3: Without it, a code sent to your WhatsApp would be enough to sign in.
passkeys.stop: To stop using Keeplas, delete your account in Settings › Account.

activity.subtitle: Sign-ins, devices and changes to your vault, newest first.

lostAccess.title: Lost access to your vault?
lostAccess.body: You can safely recover your vault using one of the options below.
lostAccess.contactsBody: Request approval from your trusted contacts (if configured).
lostAccess.kitBody: Enter your 24 words if you exported a recovery kit.
lostAccess.note: A phone verification code cannot unlock your vault.
lostAccess.deviceBody: Approve from a phone where you’re already signed in.

succession.title: Set up your succession plan
succession.body: Make sure your important information is accessible to the right people, at the right time.
succession.remindersBody: We'll remind you periodically to keep your information up to date.
succession.contactsBody: Both contacts must confirm before any access is granted.
succession.graceBody: A waiting period gives you time to respond if needed.
succession.assignedBody: Your trusted contacts can access only the content you've assigned to them.

itemActions.archiveBody: It leaves your vault and is no longer passed on to anyone. It stays whole in Settings → Archives, with its history, and you can restore it at any time.
itemActions.archiveFailed: Keeplas could not archive this item. Check your connection and try again.
itemActions.moveFailed: Keeplas could not move "{title}". Check your connection and try again.

export.title: Export my data
export.body: Keeplas decrypts your vault on this phone and puts everything in one ZIP archive you can keep or move to another app.
export.keepOpen: Keep Keeplas open until it finishes.
export.background: You can leave this screen or Keeplas: you’ll get a notification when the archive is ready.
export.notifyRunning: Decrypting your vault on this phone
export.notifyReady: Your archive is ready. Open Keeplas to save or share it.
export.notifyFailed: The export stopped before the end. Open Keeplas to try again.
export.ready: Your archive is ready ({size}). Save it to Files or share it. Your vault stays exactly as it is: only this temporary copy of the archive is cleared from Keeplas when you leave this screen.
export.failed: The export stopped before the end. Check your connection and try again. Nothing was sent anywhere.
export.warning: The archive is not encrypted. Anyone who gets the file can read it: keep it somewhere safe and delete it when you no longer need it.

contents.filesBody: Documents, photos, voice notes and videos, as added
contents.notesBody: Each note as a page you can open in a browser

export.skipped: {n} item(s) could not be opened on this phone and are not in the archive. Try exporting from the web app to include them.

deleteAccount.title: Delete my account
deleteAccount.rowBody: Erase your account and everything in it
deleteAccount.body: Your account and everything in your vault will be erased from Keeplas for good, 7 days after you confirm.

loses.items: Every item, note and file in your vault
loses.shares: What you share with your trusted contacts, and what they can open
loses.succession: Your succession plan, Life check and contact recovery
loses.plan: Your plan. Deleting your account doesn't refund a Lifetime purchase

deleteAccount.exportHint: to keep a copy of everything before it is erased.
deleteAccount.graceNote: You have 7 days to change your mind: cancel the deletion from this screen. After that, nothing can be recovered, not even by Keeplas.
deleteAccount.scheduledBody: Everything will be erased for good on {date}. Until then you can still use Keeplas and cancel the deletion.
deleteAccount.failed: Keeplas could not save your request. Check your connection and try again.

pin.label: Keeplas code
pin.sheetBody: This phone asks for your {n}-digit code before opening your vault keys.
pin.unlockBody: Enter your {n}-digit code, then confirm with your face or fingerprint.
pin.wrong: Wrong code. {n} more tries before a 1-minute pause.
pin.locked: Too many wrong codes. Try again in {seconds} s.
pin.wipedTitle: Your vault key was removed from this phone
pin.wipedBody: After 10 wrong codes Keeplas removes the key from this phone to protect it. Your vault is safe: open it again from your cloud backup or with your 24 words.
pin.body: A {n}-digit code asked after your face or fingerprint. Both are then needed to open your vault on this phone.
pin.statusOn: A Keeplas code is set on this phone.
pin.statusOff: No Keeplas code on this phone: your screen lock alone opens the vault.
pin.mismatch: The two codes are different. Choose your code again.
pin.failed: Keeplas could not save your code. Try again.
pin.forgot: Forgot your code? After 10 wrong tries, Keeplas removes the key from this phone and you open your vault again from your cloud backup or with your 24 words.
pin.why1: Your face or fingerprint can fall back to your phone passcode. Anyone who has seen it could open Keeplas.
pin.why2: With a Keeplas code, they also need these {n} digits, which only you know.
pin.why3: After 10 wrong tries, Keeplas removes the key from this phone. Your vault stays safe.

importArchive.title: Import an archive
importArchive.rowBody: Add the items of a Keeplas export
importArchive.body: Choose a ZIP made with "Export my data". Keeplas reads it on this phone, encrypts every item again and adds it to your vault.
importArchive.notes: Imported items are added to what you already have: importing the same archive twice creates duplicates. Sharing with contacts is not restored, and each item gets today’s date.
importArchive.done: {n} item(s) added. Their files upload in the background; you can follow them on Home.
importArchive.skippedFiles: {n} file(s) could not be read from the archive and were left out.
importArchive.notKeeplas: This file is not a Keeplas export. Choose the ZIP made with "Export my data", without unzipping and zipping it again.
importArchive.failed: The import stopped before the end. Items already added stay in your vault. Check your storage and try again.

linkDevice.title: Use another signed-in phone
linkDevice.body: Your other phone sends your vault key to this one, encrypted end to end. Keeplas never sees it.
linkDevice.step1: Open Keeplas on the phone where you’re signed in.
linkDevice.step3: Scan this code, check it shows the code below, then approve.
linkDevice.opening: Opening your vault on this phone…
linkDevice.expired: The code expired before it was approved. Generate a new one.
linkDevice.rejected: The other phone declined. If it wasn’t you, secure your account from that phone.
linkDevice.failed: This phone couldn’t be linked. Check your connection, then generate a new code.
linkDevice.note: Only a phone already signed in to your account can approve this code.
linkDevice.codeDetail: Approve on the other phone only if it shows this same code.

itemEdit.title: Edit
itemEdit.historyNote: The current version is kept in the history, with its files. Nothing is lost.
itemEdit.failedBody: Keeplas could not save your changes. Check your connection and try again.
itemEdit.pending: You have unsaved changes on this item.
itemEdit.discardBody: Your unsaved changes and added files will be removed from this phone. The item stays as it is saved.
itemEdit.resumed: You are picking up unsaved changes.

itemHistory.title: History
itemHistory.body: Every edit keeps the previous version, encrypted on your devices. You can read it or restore it.
itemHistory.restoreBody: The item goes back to its content of {date}. The current version is kept in the history.

archives.title: Archives
archives.rowBody: Items taken out of the vault, kept with their history
archives.body: An archived item is no longer in your vault and is not passed on to anyone. It stays whole, with its files and history. Only deleting your account erases it.
archives.space: Archives and history use {size} of your storage.
archives.restoreBody: Put it back in the vault, with its sharing
archives.restoreFailed: Keeplas could not restore this item. Check your connection and try again.
archives.emptyBody: Items you archive will show up here, with their history.

drafts.title: Drafts
drafts.homeBody: {n} in progress · tap to pick up
drafts.clearBody: Removes the text, files and settings of this draft
drafts.deleteRowBody: Also removes its files from this phone
drafts.deleteBody: The text and attached files will be removed from this phone. This cannot be undone.
drafts.emptyBody: Anything you start without saving is kept here, on this phone, to pick up later.

account.title: My account
account.removePhotoBody: Your initial will be shown instead.
account.name: Display name

legal.title: Legal identity
legal.body: Your country of residence and date of birth. You can change your country from the web app.

emailStep.bodyAdd: We'll email you a 6-digit code. Confirm it to sign in with an emailed code too.
emailStep.bodyChange: We'll email a 6-digit code to your new address. Sign-ins with the old address will stop working.
emailStep.label: Email address

phoneStep.title: Change your number
phoneStep.body: We'll send a code on WhatsApp to the new number. Sign-ins with the old number will stop working.

errors.emailTaken: This email is already linked to another account.
errors.phoneTaken: This number is already linked to another account.
errors.tooMany: Too many attempts. Try again later.
errors.proof: We couldn't confirm your vault on this phone. Try again.
errors.uploadFailed: The photo couldn't be uploaded. Try again.
errors.imageTooLarge: This image is too large. Choose one under 5 MB.
errors.tooYoung: You must be at least 18 to use Keeplas.
errors.invalidBirthday: This date of birth isn't valid.

setupPin.title: Add a Keeplas code
setupPin.later: You can add it later in Settings › Privacy and security.

backupOff.warnBody: If you lose this phone, your vault won't come back with your {account} account. Keeplas can't read your vault, so we can't restore it for you. Save your 24 words before you turn it off.
backupOff.kitBody: Without the backup, these words open your vault if you lose this phone. Save them as a PDF or an image to continue.
backupOff.confirmBody: Your backup will be deleted from Keeplas and from your {account} keychain. From now on, only your 24 words or your trusted contacts can bring your vault back. If you lose them, Keeplas can't help you.
backupOff.understand: I saved my 24 words and I understand Keeplas can't recover my vault.

kitScan.title: Scan your kit’s QR code
kitScan.body: Point the camera at the QR code on your printed kit or on the kit image.
kitScan.invalid: This QR code isn’t a Keeplas recovery kit.
kitScan.noQr: No QR code found in this image.
kitScan.paperHint: Kit without a QR code? Tap the field, then use your keyboard’s Scan Text to read the words.
